mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ctg_users (id, pw, user_name, nickname, birth, phone, email, gender, user_role, temperature) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{birth}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{gender}, "USER", 36)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ctg_users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ctg_users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ctg_users WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
SELECT nickname FROM ctg_users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
